units.summary: @types/node stays on the lowest supported Node major (root engines.node), in the root and every package that uses it
units.evidence: .github/renovate.json5:15-17 ('These need to stay pinned to match the React/Node versions we support'); package.json:179 engines.node; @types/node ^24.0.0 in the root and 8 workspace devDependencies
units.reason: R5 load-bearing comment. The semver-major of '^24.15.0 || ^26.13.0' is 24, which matches ^24.0.0.
units.fire_verified: Three cases each fired: root @types/node ^26 (+1), packages/cli ^22 (+1), engines changed to '^26.13.0 || ^28.0.0' (+9, all 9 users). The clone passes.

changes.why: R4 fails: the rule reads the first major in engines.node as the 'lowest supported major', so it depends on the order of the range. Reproduced on a scratch copy: reordering engines.node to '^26.13.0 || ^24.15.0' (the same supported set) gives a +9 false positive, and the equivalent form '>=24.15.0 <25 || >=26.13.0' gives no finding at all. The semantics (minimum major of a semver range) need a version-compare step. alint gets the answer for one spelling only, which the batch ruling makes C.

(2) backstage-valueadd-adrs-in-mkdocs: adr015 is registered in sidebars.ts but missing from the mkdocs.yml nav, which is the violated half of the ADR registration instruction.

Violations during drafting, and how I resolved them:
(a) backstage-publishconfig-no-legacy-entry-fields fired on 110 manifests. fixPackageExports returns early when a package has no `exports`, and those 110 manifests keep publishConfig main/types without an exports field. The rule is now gated on `$.exports` like the fixer and passes.
(b) backstage-skills-index-description fired twice. backstage-release-notes/SKILL.md has a second `description:` line in its body, and that skill is not in index.json. The regex is now anchored to the frontmatter, with allow_missing_target as in the script.
(c) backstage-skills-index-files fired 6 times. The orphan space matched directories, and the two unpublished skills were included. The space is now `{path}/**/*.*`, and the two unpublished skill dirs are excluded by hand (C).
(d) markdown_links_resolve gave 2 findings that verify-links.js's regex never reports: an undefined reference label in contrib/docs/tutorials/aws-alb-aad-oidc-auth.md and a parenthesised `((https://...))` destination in plugins/catalog-graph/README-alpha.md. Both files are excluded (C).
(e) A copyright-header probe over the whole repo hit templates/** (in .eslintignore) and packages/cli/asset-types/asset-types.js (`eslint-disable-next-line notice/notice`). Both are excluded to mirror the repo. 14 files outside packages/plugins (.github, .lighthouseci, .patches, .storybook, contrib) lack the header, so the scope is packages/plugins, which is what CI lints.

stage_b_summary:
Stage B for backstage/backstage at bc73976a6de26df49b2bc2eefe689ee5b3ed0af1 (js-monorepo). Stage A's config validates (72 rules) and checks clean (exit 0, 2 info) on the clone. On my own scratch copy, every dep-version and toolchain-pin A unit fired as claimed (01-06, 12, 13, 14, 15), with the exemptions holding.

The main corrections:
(1) Unit 15 is layout-dependent and goes to C. It reads the first-listed engines major: a reorder gives a +9 false positive, and an equivalent >=/< spelling gives a miss.
(2) Units 46, 49 and 53 fail R4 against verify-links.js and go to C. 46 has a different slug algorithm, reproduced in both directions. 49 and 53 are raw-text and code-block-blind, with false positives reproduced. Unit 55 is likely the same but was not reproduced.
(3) Unit 52 is the same 'missing' check as 45 (R1) and should be removed.
(4) Units 08-11 are C and should carry assertion_family none.

Seven missed units:
- b01 (A): openapi generated-router existence. validate.ts throws on it in CI, but Stage A filed it as value-add.
- b02 (A, dep-version): the create-app templates' @yarnpkg/core resolution pin, asserted in tasks.test.ts:314-337. Fire-verified with a bump and a drop.
- b03 (C, dep-version): cli-module-new versionQuery packages registered in version.ts (a regex over a TS module).
- b04 (A): mkdocs-ci.yml nav files exist, which mkdocs --strict enforces. Fire-verified.
- b05 (B-adapter route-model): Docusaurus sidebars.ts doc ids.
- b06 (C per rushstack-09b, or fold into 63): swagger-parser validation.
- b07 (B-adapter, convention without a gate): issue-template common-field sync.

Config scope gaps reproduced:
- Rule 17 misses three workflows that carry the Node matrix.
- Rule 14 misses the create-app template .yarnrc.yml.hbs yarnPath.
- Rule 48 misses root-absolute links in changesets.
- Rule 65 asserts only 3 of the header's lines, although a full-template pattern passes on the clone.

Locale absence confirmed: only test fixtures and the home plugin's locale files exist, and nothing enforces them.

Candidates checked and rejected:
- REVIEWING.md config.d.ts registration: violated by 3 plugins (aws-alb, vmware-cloud, catalog-backend-module-gitea), so R5 excludes it.
- version.ts 'accompanying devDependencies' comment: violated at the pin.
- workspaces/ui engines and yarnPath: not in any CI.
- readEntryPoints export-string and mount-slash guards: build-time guards inside the build (D 83), and they hold at the pin.
- Stage A's @backstage/ui changeset trailer claim (2 of 3 violate): confirmed.

The clone was left unmodified (git status empty, HEAD unchanged), and the scratch directory <scratch>/backstage-backstage-b was removed.

changes.detail: Fixes Stage B's reproduced gap: rule 14 checked only the root .yarnrc.yml. New rule: for_each_dir over packages/create-app/templates/* where the template has .yarnrc.yml.hbs, then registry_paths_resolve of yaml $.yarnPath with base {path} and expect file. Passes on the clone. Fires on scratch: renaming default-app's yarnPath to yarn-4.13.1.cjs gave +1; deleting legacy-app/.yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs gave +1.

Added three targets: verify_windows.yml ($.jobs.*), verify_e2e-techdocs.yml ($.jobs.*) and deploy_packages.yml ($.jobs.build only). deploy_packages' release job [24.x] and deploy_docker-image [24.x] are single-Node deploys, so they stay out. Passes on the clone. Each of these gave +1 on scratch: drop 26.x from verify_windows; drop 26.x from techdocs; add 22.x to techdocs; add 22.x to the deploy_packages build matrix. Control: changing the release job's [24.x] gave 0.

New A rule (dep-version): json_path_equals on templates/default-app and templates/legacy-app package.json.hbs, $.resolutions['@yarnpkg/core'] == "4.9.1", the two templates tasks.test.ts:314-337 checks. The third template, next-app, has only examples/. alint parses the .hbs as JSON. Passes on the clone. On scratch, a bump to 4.9.2 in default-app gave +1, and deleting the key in legacy-app gave +1. Both are policy findings, not parse failures.

New C rule (dep-version): cross_file superset. Source: the packageVersions keys in packages/cli-module-new/src/lib/version.ts, read by the regex (?m)^  '(@backstage/[^']+)':. Target: the test's own versionQuery regex over packages/cli-module-new/templates/**/*.hbs, with allow_missing_target. Passes on the clone. On scratch, a template using '@backstage/does-not-exist' gave +1, and removing the '@backstage/backend-test-utils' key gave +9 (one per template). Control: a call with a version hint, which the test ignores, gave 0.

Promoted backstage-valueadd-openapi-generated-router to level error. The old rule was a file_graph derive_target that required the new layout only, so it is replaced. New rule: for_each_file over {packages,plugins}/*/src/schema/openapi.yaml with file_exists any-of [{dir}/openapi/generated/router.ts, {dir}/openapi.generated.ts], as validate.ts does. Passes on the clone (6 specs). On scratch, deleting events-backend's router.ts gave +1, and a new spec with no router gave +1. Control: the legacy openapi.generated.ts layout alone gave 0.

PARTIAL C rule. Swagger-parser Parser.validate needs the OpenAPI meta-schema, which the clone does not ship and a standalone corpus config cannot carry. The added yaml_path_absent asserts only the top-level requirements: openapi matches 3[.][01][.][0-9]+, info.title and info.version are strings, and paths, components or webhooks is present. Nested-schema validity and $ref resolution are not covered. Passes on the clone. On scratch, openapi: 2.0.0 gave +1 and dropping info.title gave +1. Control: 3.0.3 gave 0.

New A rule: registry_paths_resolve, source mkdocs-ci.yml, yaml $.nav..[?match(@, '[^:]+')], base docs (mkdocs.yml sets no docs_dir, so the default applies), expect file. It resolves the 11 overview entries. Passes on the clone. On scratch, deleting docs/overview/roadmap.md gave +1, and renaming the vision.md nav entry to visions.md gave +1. Control: an external https nav entry gave 0.

Fixes Stage B's reproduced gap: root-absolute links in changesets were skipped. Added root: {url_prefix: '/', dir: '.changeset/__root-absolute-links-are-forbidden__'}. That directory does not exist, so every root-absolute route is reported. relative: forbid is kept, and the rule stays CommonMark-aware. Passes on the clone. Each of these gave +1 on scratch: /package.json; /docs/overview/vision.md, whose target exists; bare /; and ../docs/overview/vision.md. Controls gave 0: an https link, and /package.json inside a ``` fenced block. Remaining edge differences from the script are noted in the comment: the script skips any URL containing [a-z]+: and flags //host.

The pattern is now the whole 15-line scripts/templates/copyright-header.txt, with YEAR as \d{4}, unanchored, and lines raised from 20 to 30. Before, only the first 3 lines were asserted. Passes on the clone. Each of these gave +1 on scratch: a new .ts with no header; header line 11 altered (outside the old pattern); header line 14 altered. Controls gave 0: a shebang plus an eslint directive above the header, and a different year.

Relabelled C per Stage B: the rule reads the first engines.node alternative, so it depends on the order. Rule kept at error with a comment. No in-config fix exists, because the minimum major of a range needs version-compare. Still passes on the clone.

Relabelled C per Stage B: the GitHub slugger differs from verify-links.js headingToSlug ([*_] and punctuation), reproduced by Stage B in both directions. markdown_fragments_resolve has no slug-style option. Rule kept at error. Passes on the clone.

Relabelled C. The raw-text regex does not skip code blocks; the script strips ``` blocks first. Stage C re-reproduced it: ](/docs/overview/vision) inside a fenced block gave +1 on scratch. No code-block-aware scope exists for raw-text kinds. Rule kept at error. Passes on the clone.
Relabelled C, for the same code-block reason as 49. Stage C re-reproduced it: a multi-line [two\nlines](x.md) inside a fenced block gave +1. Rule kept at error. Passes on the clone.

Stage B only inferred this; Stage C reproduced it. [x](https://exa<U+200B>mple.com) inside a ``` fenced block fires the rule (+1 on scratch). By reading verify-links.js (not running it): verifyFile applies stripCodeBlocks before it extracts links, so the script never checks that link. Control: the same link outside a block fires in both. Relabelled C; rule kept at error. Passes on the clone.

Stage B removed unit 52 as an R1 duplicate of 45 (verify-links 'missing'). The rule is kept at level info with a comment: it is the GitHub master-URL input form of 45's check, so it is not counted separately. 0 findings on the clone.

Stage B's issue was not reproduced and is not a defect at the pin. Spectral checks inline path parameters plus the component parameters that paths reference ($ref-resolved); alint descends into all of components. A scan of '#/components/parameters/<name>' references shows every component parameter in the six specs is referenced, so a paths-only query would miss them. The broader query is kept, with a comment on the unreferenced-component false-positive edge. Unchanged; passes on the clone.
B-adapter (route-model: Docusaurus sidebar doc ids from a TS module), so no rule. Listed in the config header.
B-adapter (structured-subtree equality across issue forms), so no rule. Listed in the config header.
